name: Push-up
formTips: Hands just wider than your shoulders, under your shoulders
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your body stays straight from head to heels
Keep your elbows back at about 45° to your body
Lower until your chest is just above the floor
Push the floor away until your arms are straight, without locking the elbows
commonMistakes: Elbows flaring straight out to the sides
Letting the head drop towards the floor
